name: My FemBoyFriend Phone
source:
“My FemBoyFriend Phone” is a game that lets you dive into the cozy and intimate relationship you’ve always dreamed of with a femboy. Every choice you make shapes your story with Alex, your adorable and charming partner.
Will you take the lead and guide him, or will you embrace the submissive role? The same choice applies to Alex—will he remain sweet and devoted, or will he slowly change under external influences?
The game features multiple paths. Everything that happens in your relationship with Alex is in your hands!
translation:
“My FemBoyFriend Phone”是一款游戏，可让你与女男孩建立你一直梦想的舒适而亲密的关系。你所做的每一个选择都会塑造你与你可爱迷人的伴侣亚历克斯的故事。
你会带头引导他，还是会接受顺从的角色？同样的选择也适用于亚历克斯——他会保持甜蜜和忠诚，还是会在外界影响下慢慢改变？
游戏具有多条路径。你和亚历克斯的关系中发生的一切都掌握在你的手中！
